item.description:
EasyReels 0.1.0

First release. Drop in a sermon — or a whole service — and get back vertical clips ready to post.

  • Transcribes on your Mac, then asks Apple Intelligence which moments stand on their own.
  • Handles a whole service: the worship set and the announcements are skipped, and only the preaching is searched.
  • Keeps the preacher in frame, burns in captions with the spoken word highlighted, and exports 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9.
  • Title cards in four looks, your church logo and colours, saved as presets.
  • Writes the blog post, devotional, discussion guide, social posts and quotes to go with the clips.
  • Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

First launch: macOS will block it once. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway. You only do this once — updates never ask again.
